scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:harness && bun run build:editor && bun run build:engine
scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/workspace build && bun run --cwd packages/desktop-runtime build && bun run --cwd packages/ai-core build && bun run --cwd packages/ui build
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:harness && bun run typecheck:editor && bun run typecheck:engine
scripts.typecheck:engine: bun run --cwd packages/engine typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/engine typecheck:tests && bun run --cwd packages/engine typecheck:tooling && bun run --cwd packages/engine typecheck:examples
scripts.test: bun run test:repository && bun run test:packages && bun run test:harness && bun run test:editor && bun run test:engine
scripts.test:repository: bun test scripts/check-repository-size.test.ts scripts/check-source-structure.test.ts scripts/check-code-style.test.ts scripts/eslint-config.test.ts scripts/check-license-scope.test.ts scripts/app-ui-boundary.test.ts scripts/documentation-policy.test.ts scripts/release-readiness.test.ts
scripts.test:packages: bun test packages/ai-core packages/workspace packages/desktop-runtime packages/ui
scripts.lint: bunx eslint --config eslint.config.mjs packages apps/harness/cli/src apps/harness/scripts apps/harness/ui/src apps/engine-editor/src packages/engine/src packages/engine/scripts packages/engine/examples scripts
scripts.lint:fix: bunx eslint --config eslint.config.mjs --fix packages/ai-core packages/desktop-runtime packages/workspace apps/harness/cli/src apps/harness/scripts packages/engine/src packages/engine/scripts packages/engine/examples scripts
